FIELDS.NAME: ValueMart Discount Store
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
ValueMart Discount Store operates as a discount department store offering a wide variety of consumer goods, including clothing, household items, electronics, and personal care products. We focus primarily on in-store sales, providing a physical shopping experience to customers in our suburban location, which enhances community engagement and customer loyalty. Our store layout is designed for easy navigation, promoting an enjoyable shopping experience. We maintain robust inventory management practices to keep our product range updated and appealing to our clientele. We do not engage in significant food preparation or installation services, ensuring compliance with retail regulations while minimizing risks associated with non-retail operations. Our team is well-trained in customer service and safety protocols to enhance security and customer satisfaction.

Our department store primarily sells products through our online platform, generating over 75% of our revenue from e-commerce transactions while also maintaining a brick-and-mortar presence for customer support and local sales.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: OnlineRetailHub, an e-commerce platform focusing on discount consumer goods and operated separately from the physical store.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: No losses reported. Business primarily engages in physical retail operations, adhering to compliance requirements.

FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – The business does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Its operations are focused solely on retail with no involvement in hazardous material management.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – ValueMart Discount Store does not sponsor any athletic teams. The focus is solely on retail operations, and there are no initiatives related to sports sponsorships.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Certificates are typically verified by the insured party or their risk management team to ensure compliance and reduce liability exposure.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: Yes – The store has experienced a decline in coverage as it operates an e-commerce platform, OnlineRetailHub, which generates significant online revenue.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – ValueMart Discount Store does not lease employees to or from other employers, focusing solely on its in-house staff for retail operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – ValueMart Discount Store does not carry Workers Compensation as it does not have any employees and operates primarily as a physical retail store. Additionally, due to revenue from online operations exceeding acceptable limits, coverage is ineligible.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – ValueMart Discount Store owns and operates an additional business, OnlineRetailHub, which is an e-commerce platform focusing on discount consumer goods, separate from its physical retail operations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – ValueMart Discount Store is not eligible for coverage as it generates more than 75% of revenue from online sales through its e-commerce platform, OnlineRetailHub. Therefore, any insurance with this company cannot be processed.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – ValueMart Discount Store does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Its operations are focused solely on retailing a variety of consumer goods.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – ValueMart Discount Store does not rent or loan equipment to others as part of its retail operations. The business primarily focuses on offering a variety of consumer goods for sale directly to customers in-store.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – ValueMart Discount Store has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. All operations are focused on compliant retail practices without significant financial distress.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – ValueMart Discount Store does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as its operations focus solely on retailing a variety of consumer goods without any hazardous materials involvement.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: Yes – ValueMart Discount Store generates over 75% of its revenue from online sales through its e-commerce platform, OnlineRetailHub, which makes it ineligible for coverage under the current guidelines.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – ValueMart Discount Store has not reported any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse, molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The operations focus on retail with no significant risk exposure in these areas.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – ValueMart Discount Store does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. The business maintains compliance with fire safety regulations and ensures the safety of its operations.
